title: The Loose Border Again
author: Wendell Sterling
blurb: Odile Nakamura, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
